substeps.caption: A loading slide (ours) on the XY table runs the mount holder out to the front, clear of the head and the turret.
The conductive hot mount goes on the holder from above, against its V-block (a 5 mm plate: the polished face where the objectives focus).
The slide runs back in, under the turret.
The motorized turret swings the Vickers indenter over it; the force motor presses: HV0.1, 0.98 N.
The 50x objective comes back. The 3 MP camera images the indent; AVPAK measures both diagonals.
A row across the coupon, 0.25 mm apart (drawn 2.5 mm apart and 1.2 mm across), each made and read the same way, unattended.
315 x 671 x 595 mm and 43 kg: on a tray. HM-220: 0.05 gf to 2 kgf.
The slide runs out and the mount comes off.
The slide runs out and the mount comes off.
